brief:
## The product: Classroom Widgets (by Tinkertanker, Singapore)
A teacher toolkit of live classroom widgets, projected in front of a class. Web app plus macOS/Windows/Linux desktop apps that launch widgets as floating panels from a menu-bar/tray item.

## LOOK AT THE REAL APP FIRST (mandatory — Read these images before designing)
- /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/ref/vernacular.png — one sheet showing what teachers actually see: a live board, close-ups, the timer runner cast.
- /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/ref/c-timer-running.png — the TIMER: the app's signature widget. A big cream disc inside a thick RAINBOW ring that depletes as time runs down, a big number in the middle, and a little creature (hamster, fox, tortoise, bee, penguin, "pip") running along the ring.
- /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/ref/c-timer-zero.png — the timer at zero ("Time's Up!").
- /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/ref/c-randomiser.png — the RANDOMISER: a cream card holding a slot-machine window with a purple→pink→amber gradient; three stacked name pills, the middle (chosen) one bright white and bold.
- /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/ref/c-confetti.png — CONFETTI bursts across the board when the randomiser lands (small red, yellow, teal and navy flecks and strips).
- /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/ref/c-thumbs.png, c-heart.png, c-star.png, c-rainbow.png, c-smiley.png — STICKERS teachers slap on the board: chunky, bright (pink, blue, orange, emerald, purple, yellow), tilted, with a thick WHITE die-cut border and a soft drop shadow.
- /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/ref/c-traffic.png — the traffic light (dark pill, three glossy lamps).
- /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/ref/00-empty.png — the canvas itself: a warm AMBER/caramel low-poly background with pale frosted toolbar buttons.
The client's note: previous rounds were "not super inspired, and don't look a lot like what Classroom Widgets users see — usually a timer (circle), randomiser etc (some rectangles), stickers. Maybe confetti." A teacher should look at the icon and think "that's the thing with the rainbow timer and the name picker". Abstract tile geometry is out.

## Surfaces this ONE mark must serve
1. macOS app icon — 1024 squircle (plate rect x=100 y=100 w=824 h=824 rx=185; content may overhang the plate slightly but must stay inside the canvas).
2. Windows (.ico 16–256), Linux (256 full-bleed) and PWA icons — derived by scaling the plate to fill the canvas, so it must survive full-bleed and on light app grids.
3. Menu bar (macOS template: one colour + alpha at ~18pt) and system tray (Windows ~16px white on dark; GNOME symbolic white). Today this is a generic 3×3 dot grid; the client wants something that is recognisably this app.
4. Web favicon (16/32).

## Colour
Use the app's REAL colours where they carry recognition: the rainbow ring, the purple→pink→amber slot gradient, bright sticker colours with white die-cut borders, the amber canvas, cream widget surfaces. The brand UI palette (sages #86b49f #5a9483 / deep sage #2f5646, terracottas #d4775c #c25e42, dusty rose #d99185, cream #fdfcfb, amber canvas ≈ #a8692a→#c98a3c) is the calm frame around them. Keep it joyful but not garish: ≤ 3 focal elements, one clear hero.

## ROUND 3 — what 162 evaluator verdicts taught us (binding)
Round-2 winner, unanimous (first place with all nine evaluators): "Rainbow Countdown" — the app's cream timer face inside a thick round-capped rainbow ring, depleted so a pale spent gap shows at upper-left, a big bold 5 on the face, white die-cut rim, amber plate. Glyph: a bold 5 inside a 260° C-ring. CLIENT OVERRIDE: the client rejects the numeral — "I'd rather there's nothing inside than a random number." NO digits anywhere in round 3. Read its contact sheet: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/sheets/r2-ring.png, and the round-2 overview /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/sheets/r2-overview.png.
Why it won: one centred hero that fits the 80% maskable circle (PWA/Android crops), survives true 16px, and its glyph is the icon with colour removed. Why others lost: collages of several widgets (timer + card + sticker + confetti) crowd the plate edges, clip under circular masks and turn to mush at 16px; pictorial glyphs (full-body hamster, star, heart) blob at tray size.
Fix these in every concept:
- ONE centred hero inside the 80% circle; at most one small supporting accent.
- Glyph = ONE solid tone. No 50% opacity anywhere (it reads as a disabled menu item). Draw it as a sign with a closed outline, SF Symbols weight — not a shrunken illustration. Must hold at TRUE 1x 16px on a 100%-scaling school PC.
- Look-alikes to avoid: SF Symbols goforward.5 / gobackward.5 (a digit inside an open arc with an arrowhead-like cap — keep caps round, never arrow-shaped), a refresh/reload arrow, the letter G or C, Google One's numeral-in-multicolour-ring, a glowing AI halo (smooth rainbow halos now read as "AI feature"). A clearly segmented or clearly flat ring helps.
- NO NUMERAL. The face is left empty (clean cream), or holds the app hamster where a direction says so. Without the numeral the glyph loses its anchor, so a bare C-ring risks reading as a loading spinner, a refresh arrow or the letter C: each concept must get its identity from the ring itself (the spent gap, its caps, segments, the hamster, the sticker) — solve that explicitly and say how in your concept text.
- Low-poly facets vanish below 64px and look dated: at most two or three large flat facets, and none in the small master. If an amber plate sits on the app's own amber canvas it needs a cream outline to separate.
- Deliver a real macOS DARK appearance variant and a hand-tuned SMALL master (16–32px: flat, fewer segments, heavier strokes).
- THE HAMSTER MUST BE THE APP'S HAMSTER. Read /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/ref/hamster.png (the real in-app hamster, calm and shocked). Its exact SVG is /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-classroom-widgets/1019d9be-4c14-5465-b2e2-1ffcd8946341/scratchpad/ref/hamster-calm.svg (viewBox -12..12): an orange #D2691E oval body, a big round tan #DEB887 head at the front-left, two round orange ear circles on top of the head, a brown #8B4513 outline, two black dot eyes with white glints, a small brown nose dot, four stubby dark-brown feet and a curly brown tail. EMBED THAT MARKUP (scaled and positioned with a transform) rather than redrawing it; you may thicken outlines for small sizes but must keep its silhouette and features. The round-2 leaping hamster did not look like the app's and was rejected by the client. For the glyph, the hamster reduces to its silhouette: round head + two round ears (+ body/tail if it survives 16px).
- Optional but valued: describe a live menu-bar state (the ring emptying as a timer runs) in your concept text.

## Non-negotiables
- Colour icon, dark icon, small master and glyph are ONE mark. Glyph: viewBox 0 0 1024 1024, #000 fills only, one solid tone, no gradients/filters/opacity; strokes only as stroke="#000" fill="none".
- Icons: viewBox 0 0 1024 1024, self-contained, no text and no numerals.
- CRITICAL: prefix ids — icon "{{SLUG}}-", iconDark "{{SLUG}}d-", iconSmall "{{SLUG}}s-", glyph "{{SLUG}}g-".

directions.title: The master ring — Rainbow Countdown, refined
directions.brief: Take the round-2 winner to final quality WITHOUT the numeral: cream face left clean and empty, round-capped rainbow ring with the spent gap, white die-cut rim. Fix every note: caps round and clearly not arrowheads, ring colours deepened so it reads as an object not a glowing halo, plate reduced to two or three flat amber facets (or a clean amber gradient), all inside the 80% circle. The hard part: with an empty face the glyph must still read as "our timer" and not a spinner, a refresh arrow or the letter C — e.g. show the spent track as a thin closed inner outline so the gap reads as time used, weight the ring heavily, choose a gap position and cap shape that nothing else uses. This is the minimal, confident option.

directions.title: Ring + the hamster riding the leading cap
directions.brief: The master ring (empty face) with THE APP'S OWN HAMSTER — embed the real in-app markup from hamster-calm.svg, do not redraw it — small, about a quarter of the ring's diameter, running along the ring's leading end exactly where the app runs it. The hamster is the signature that makes the ring ownable. Glyph: the C-ring with the hamster's silhouette (round head + two round ears, plus body if it survives 16px) fused onto the leading cap — that is what kills the spinner and skip-arrow reads.

directions.title: Ring + a gold star sticker in the spent gap
directions.brief: The master ring (empty face) with ONE small die-cut gold star sticker (the app's own sticker style: chunky, thick white border, slight tilt) sitting in the spent gap — a "well done" wink that fills the gap and makes the C-shape unambiguous. Star about 25% of the ring diameter. Glyph: C-ring + a solid star in the gap, separated by ≥100-unit knockouts.

directions.title: Segmented rainbow dial
directions.brief: Answer the "AI halo / Google One" risk: the ring rebuilt as 6–8 chunky round-ended segments in rainbow order (like coloured dial blocks), with the last one or two segments missing as the spent time; face left empty. Flat, graphic, toy-like, unmistakably a countdown and not a glow. Glyph: the segmented arc as solid blocks — the blocks themselves are the identity; must stay crisp at 16px (fewer, bigger segments if needed, ≥100-unit gaps).

directions.title: The ring in the brand palette
directions.brief: The calm continuity option: the same ring (empty face), but the arc coloured in the brand family (deep sage → sage → terracotta → dusty rose) instead of a full rainbow, on a cream-to-pale-sage plate like the currently shipping icon — or on deep sage with a cream face. Still recognisably the app's timer. For a client who liked the original grid's calm palette. Glyph identical in construction to the master ring.

directions.title: The app hamster inside the ring
directions.brief: The hamster as the hero: THE APP'S OWN HAMSTER (embed hamster-calm.svg, do not redraw) large and centred inside the rainbow ring's cream face — the face becomes its home, filling the space where the numeral used to be. The ring is depleted with a clear gap. Charming and instantly the app's. Glyph: the ring with the hamster silhouette inside (round head + two round ears, body if it survives), separated from the ring by a ≥100-unit knockout; must read at true 16px.

directions.title: The randomiser reel — a timer-free alternative
directions.brief: Keep a non-timer option alive for the final choice: the randomiser as a vertical reel — a cream card with the purple→pink→amber window, three stacked name pills cropped by the window, the middle one solid white and bold, neighbours half-hidden; at most two small paper confetti flecks. Centred and large (≥70% of the plate width), no corner placement. Glyph: a framed vertical stack of three pills, the middle solid, the outer ones drawn as outlines (no opacity) — must read as "pick one", not a battery or toaster.

directions.title: Hero ring with a supporting widget strip
directions.brief: The "Widgets, plural" story without a collage: the master ring takes two-thirds of the plate as the clear hero, and a small vertical traffic-light pill (dark pill, three lamps) tucks against its lower-right, overlapping the ring slightly. Everything inside the 80% circle. Face left empty. Glyph: C-ring with a small solid pill (three knocked-out dots, or a notch) fused at the lower-right — not two unrelated objects.

directions.title: The ring as a die-cut sticker
directions.brief: Brand-system option: the whole mark treated as one of the app's stickers — the rainbow timer ring + face as a sticker with a thick white die-cut outline and a soft shadow, lifted slightly off a flat amber (or deep sage) plate, tilted a few degrees. The die-cut outline becomes the brand's style for web, docs and marketing. Glyph: the sticker's closed outer outline with the C-ring inside as a knockout (empty face).
